Georgia Southern's red zone defense ranks 62nd at 84.6%. Coastal Carolina ranks 113th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 28:02, compared to Georgia Southern's 49th-ranked average of 31:20. Team leaders Georgia Southern Passing: Max Johnson, 996 yards, 5 TDs, 1 INT, 66.2 completion percentage Rushing: David Mbadinga, 172 yards on 29 carries, 0 TDs Receiving: Ashton Hollins, 202 yards on 14 catches, 2 TDs Coastal Carolina Passing: Deuce Bailey, 1,039 yards, 10 TDs, 2 INTs, 54.1 completion percentage Rushing: Jevon Edwards, 137 yards on 42 carries, 0 TDs Receiving: Colton Hinton, 220 yards on 10 catches, 4 TDs Last game Georgia Southern fell 42-28 to Houston on Sept. 26. Alex Taylor had six receptions for 119 yards and two touchdowns. Coastal Carolina fell 34-17 to Liberty on Sept. 24. Bailey led Coastal Carolina with 213 yards on 17-of-34 passing (50.0%) for two touchdowns and two interceptions. He also carried the ball 15 times for 31 yards. Dominic Knicely carried the ball five times for 25 yards. Tristian Gardner had four receptions for 86 yards and one touchdown. Next game Georgia Southern hosts James Madison on Oct. 10. Coastal Carolina plays at Marshall on Oct. 10.
